description: This file defines a React component named ProductsPage that renders a product catalog page. It manages fetching product data from an API, filtering, pagination, and user interactions such as adding items to a cart. It also includes formatting and matching utility functions for displaying product details.

methods.name: formatInstant
methods.description: Formats an ISO timestamp string into a human-readable string with ISO date and time, replacing 'T' and trimming to seconds.

methods.name: matchesQuery
methods.description: Checks if a product matches the current search query based on SKU, type, or availability status.
